paite: Huai nung in Pathian in Mosi kiang ah, “TOUPA kiang ah hong tou in, nang leh Aaron, Nadab leh Abihu leh Israel upate lak a sawmsagihte, gamlapi a pan in Pathian bia un.
heading: Thukhun Hihkip Ahi

paite: Mosi kia TOUPA kiang ah ahong pai ding, himahleh amau ahong pai nai louh ding uh ahi. Mite leng amah toh ahong hohtouh louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Mosi ahong pai a, TOUPA thute leh vaihawmna tengteng mite ahilhta hi. Mite'n aw kituak in adawng ua, "TOUPA'N agen thu tengteng ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
TOUPA thu tengteng Mosi in agelh a, zingsang in beltak in athou a, tang nuai ah maitam abawl a, Israel nam sawm-le-nih dungzui in, khuam sawm-le-nih aphut hi.
Ama'n Israel suante lak a tangvalte asawl a, amau TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillat in bawngtalte alan uhi.
Mosi in bawngtalte sisan kimkhat ala a, kuangdai sung ah akoih a; maitam tung ah asisan kimkhat atheh hi.
Thukhun Laibu ala a, mite zak in asim hi. Mite'n, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng hih in athu ka mang ding uhi," achi uhi.
Mosi in sisan ala a mite tung ah atheh a, "Thukhun sisan en un, hiai thu tengteng thu a TOUPA'N akhun," achi hi.
Mosi, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu leh Israel Upa sawmsagihte apaitou ua
Israel' Pathian ava mu uhi. Akhepek nuai ah sapphir a bawl hileh kilawm leh van bang a siang a-om hi.
Himahleh Israel suante lak a upate dou in Pathian in atung uah akhut alik kei hi. Amau leng Pathian mu napi in hingdam a om in ne in adawn uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Tang ah ka kiang ah hong tou inla, huai ah om in. Suangpekte a ka gelhsa dan leh thupiakte ka hon pe ding; amaute na sinsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
heading: Sinai Tang Tung Ah Mosi

paite: Mosi leh amah huhpa Joshua adingkhia ua, Pathian tang ah ahohtou uhi.

Upate kiang ah, na kiang ua ka hong kik nawn masiah uh hiai ah hon ngak un. "Ngai un, Aaron leh Hur na ompih uhi. Mi kuapeuh in thubuai bangpeuh gen ding na neih uleh, amah akiang uah hong hoh hen," achi hi.
Tang ah Mosi ahohtou a, meipi in tang akhuhta hi.
Sinai Tang tung ah TOUPA thupina a-om a, meipi in ni guk sung akhuh hi. Ani sagih ni in meipi lak a kipan Mosi asamta hi.
Tang vum tung a TOUPA thupina, Israel suante muh in kangmang thei meikuang bang ahi.
Meipi lak ah Mosi alutta a, tang ah ava hohtou hi. Mosi tang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ava omta hi.
